_comment: Written by the daily run. ideas: proposed briefs. watchlist: promising but under-evidenced. rejected: looked at seriously and dropped. Incumbents are App Store app ids.

ideas.title: Fifty Hours (working name)
ideas.evidence: RoadReady (2.9, 19k ratings): 87 low-star reviews in 90d, 128 since May 2026, us only, rising monthly after the June rewrite: login 51, lost hours 27, ads 14. RoadReady Ohio 6 in 90d and Aceable's log 2 share the complaint

watchlist.evidence: Untappd 5.0 redesign (2026-10-15): 87 low-star reviews on v5.0.x 2026-10-16..10-31 (us 66, gb 21; only 1 low-star in the 2 months before), themes UI clutter 48, friends feed 17, own history/tracking 12, ads 10, Insider paywall 7 (Untappd 216k ratings us, grossing in 2). Vivino 2026.33-2026.43 rebuild: ~15 of 25 low-star reviews (us, gb, 2026-08-13..10-30) about personal logging getting worse: can't edit wine/year, no manual entry, tasted wines lost, cellar notes removed (Vivino 140k ratings us). Competitors are tiny or single-drink: Bruwia (free, beer, imports Untappd history), Vinocell ($9.99, wine cellar, 1.8k), CellarTracker (650), Beerstory/Tastings/BrewGene/Pint Please (0-75 ratings). Untappd check-in export is Insider-only (GDPR request in the EU). 2026-11-03 rescan: Untappd 91 low-star in 90d (us 69, gb 22), now on 5.0.2, still 2-6 a day at month end; Vivino 26 (us 20, gb 6), still on 2026.42-43. 2026-11-04 rescan: Untappd 92 low-star in 90d (us 70, gb 28 all-time stored), still 1-6 a day to 11-01, 1 in November so far; Vivino 27
watchlist.promote_if: the Untappd/Vivino complaints are still coming 4+ weeks on (after Untappd 5.1 and the next Vivino release), appear in ≥3 more storefronts, ≥3 independent off-store threads show people leaving for a private log, and there's evidence of willingness to pay (asks for a one-time paid journal, or Insider/Premium cancellations citing logging). Otherwise reject: drinkers are used to free apps, and Bruwia already imports Untappd history for free

watchlist.evidence: Timehop (186k ratings, ~12M installs, 74% ad revenue per AppGoblin): 43 low-star reviews in 90d, 70 in 12 months (us, gb), rising since v5.0 (2026-07), from 8-12 year users with long streaks: unskippable ads, camera-roll photos stuck at 0%, memories and streaks moved behind Timehop+. Competitors are on-device and tiny: Photo Flashback (free, 4.9, 256 ratings), On This Day Rewind ($4.99 one-time, streaks, widgets, MacStories review, 8 ratings), Ayer, Latent, Tiny Whale, ThenNow, Photura, Memozie, ChronoPics. About 14 clones, none with traction. 2026-11-04 rescan: 44 in 90d (22 in the last 30); no off-store threads of people leaving found
watchlist.promote_if: a differentiator the clones lack, shown on the first screen (e.g. a real daily-streak ritual with streak carry-over that long-time users respond to), off-store threads of people leaving, and explicit willingness to pay; most reviewers are angry about paying at all

rejected.reason: fix already crowded (TrialGuard, Trial Alert, TrialHero, Bobby, ReSubs); no subscription API on iOS; finance-adjacent; 4.3 risk high
LocalSend already free, open-source, ad-free
AI inference cost drives the ads; fails Gate B economics; evidence mostly one storefront
background removal built into iOS; rest is billing disputes
needs caller/spam database and Call Directory extension
two-sided dating marketplace; fails Gate B
licensed content; fails Gate B
review scan found no recent complaints; paid charts only in tiny storefronts; generic workout category, high 4.3 risk
only 5 low-star reviews in 90d; crowded with Anki-compatible apps (AnkiApp, Noji, RemNote)
dropbox.com web already lets over-quota users get files out; API-dependent one-off export, no recurring value

~125 low-star reviews (sa, us, ae, gb, pk, my) on immodest ads while reading; killed by free ad-free Quran.com app (4.9, 33.9k), iQuran (4.8, 30.9k, no ads/no subs), Greentech Al Quran (4.8, 19.1k); 4.3 risk high
~51 low-star reviews on ads blocking prayer times/adhan; killed by Pillars (4.8, 5.6k, free, no ads), MAWAQIT (4.9, 6.3k), Pray Watch (4.8, 9.3k), iPray ($1.99, 4.8, 9k)
VN (4.8, 323k, free, no watermark) and InShot already fill it; video editor not a 14-day build
redesign backlash (~20 reviews); drawing engine not feasible in Expo/14 days

14 low-star reviews, 7 apps (sa, ae, ca, us, gb, my) on paying for prayer times/adhan/reciters/widgets; killed by fully free ad-free MAWAQIT (4.9, 6.3k), Pray Watch (4.8, 9.3k), IslamApp (4.9, 6.0k), Quran.com (4.9, 33.9k), iQuran (4.8, 30.9k)
15 reviews of lifetime/one-time buyers re-charged or unable to restore; billing dispute, and iPray ($1.99 one-time, 4.8, 9.1k) plus free apps already serve one-time buyers
~13-16 reviews of missed adhan/wrong times since Athan Pro 9.0 + iOS 27 (Sept 2026); incumbent regression, and MAWAQIT, Pray Watch, iPray already reliable
10 reviews (lost bookmarks/position, Quran Pro 6 redesign, Ayah removed Ibn Kathir/Sa'di tafsir); Quran.com and iQuran already do this free; tafsir is licensed
~9 low-star reviews, one storefront (in), on basic edits paywalled at save time; fails Gate A; Snapseed free/ad-free already covers it; full photo editor not a 14-day build

~15 relevant reviews, still one app (targeted rescan of SCRL + 9 carousel competitors 2026-11-01 got 0 reviews); SwipeMix (4.8, 6k) already sells one-time packs, Seam is free/ad-supported, ~10 other splitters (Panoslice, SWVY, Crsel, FlowGrid, Unfurl, InstaSlide); the 'needs IG professional account' pain disappears with any save-to-camera-roll splitter; high 4.3 risk

43 low-star reviews (us, gb, hr, rs) on an ad every 2-3 letters and $15/week to use your handwriting font; fails Gate B: iOS keyboards can only insert Unicode text, so a custom font can't be typed into Messages/WhatsApp (reviewers say Fontmaker's doesn't work either); mostly young users
9 reviews on $9.99/week for a Bible + widget; YouVersion Bible (4.9, 178k, free) and many free KJV/verse-of-the-day apps already do it
7 reviews (us) wanting Instagram/Facebook import and photo-of-handwritten-recipe; ReciMe (4.8, 324k) already does social import and scanning; fails Gate A
tracing-projector apps are a clone category (dozens of AR tracing apps, mostly weekly subs) and free ones exist; a cheaper copy is a 4.3 risk; targeted scan returned no reviews
83 low-star reviews on a paywalled result after the photo; needs face matching against celebrity images (AI + image rights); fails Gate B
18 reviews on forced rating prompts, manual one-by-one cleaning and trial charges; photo-cleaner category is crowded (Cleanup 750k ratings) and the pain is dark patterns, not a missing workflow
32 reviews (us, de, au) on tracking gaps since iOS 27 and dropped old watches; watchOS + deep HealthKit, fails Gate B
18 reviews (gb) on battery drain since v26.41 plus price; a recent regression, and reliable alarms need native AlarmKit work, fails Gate B

Gate A passes across 2 apps: VSCO ~13 reviews (us, gb, ar) on free tools moved to Pro, plus Esti ~12 (us) on 'pay for everything' and AI-filter credits. Killed by Dazz Cam (4.8, 103k ratings, film looks with a $19.99 one-time Pro) and Snapseed (free, no account); VSCO's paywall moves date back to 2022; crowded filter category, 4.3 risk

17 low-star reviews in 90d (gb only) from shoppers sent by merchants to an app charging £10/week to track one parcel; AfterShip (4.7, 333k, free tracking) and 17TRACK already do it free, and carrier data needs a paid tracking API (fails Gate B)

72 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb) about AI-made, inaccurate patterns and nearly every pattern being Pro-only; the fix is a pattern library (content you can't license or produce in 14 days, fails Gate B), and Ravelry/YouTube already give free patterns

50 + 20 low-star reviews (us, gb) from people sent to look-alike authenticator apps charging $9.99/week; free Google/Microsoft Authenticator and the built-in iOS Passwords codes already do it, so there is no gap to build into

143 low-star reviews in 90d (gb, us, ca, au), ~50 about being forced into a trial of a 'free' recipe saver; killed by a crowded field: Mela+ ($6.99 one-time) reads Instagram/TikTok/YouTube descriptions, Recipe Keeper ($19.99 one-time), Paprika ($4.99), plus free tiers of Peel, Recipe Notes, Flavorish; video import needs AI; high 4.3 risk
76 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb); no update since 2025-07 and trimmed recordings can't be saved for ~a year; Apple Voice Memos is free and built in, with trimming and transcription

45 low-star reviews in 90d (us) about the free tier losing radar and storm tracks after the 2026 redesign; free radar is already in Apple Weather and MyRadar, and radar data beyond US NEXRAD needs licensing

33 low-star reviews in 90d across Pillars (14; us, gb, ae) and Niyat (19; us, au, ca) about a long unskippable onboarding survey ending in a paywall before basic prayer/Quran features; same kill as paywall:islamic-apps:basic-worship-features: MAWAQIT, Quran.com, Pray Watch and IslamApp are free and ad-free with no survey

110 low-star reviews in 90d (us) about the price going from ~$99 to ~$250/yr and the free tier shrinking; notes apps are a crowded category (Apple Notes free, UpNote lifetime, Obsidian, Bear), so a cheaper notes app is a 4.3 risk with no clear gap

14 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb; several in Spanish) about push alerts being Pro-only and arriving late; under Gate A volume, and free MyShake, LastQuake (EMSC) and Earthquake Network already send alerts; real early warning needs a sensor network

91 low-star reviews in 90d (us 77, gb 14) since StrongLifts went subscription-only (free tier and lifetime Power Pack dropped, $59.99/yr), plus a disliked 4.4 watch/UI redesign; the strongest pain of the day, but killed: Lift5x5 (free core 5x5 with auto-progression, imports StrongLifts CSV, lifetime option), 5x5 Workout Lifting Tracker ($9.99 one-time, watch), 5x5 Workout by Zen Labs (4.7, 1.6k, $8.99 Pro) and other 2025-26 clones already do it, so another 'same but one-time' 5x5 app is a 4.3 risk; watch logging (much loved) is out of Expo scope

Liftoff (39), Fitbod (36), Gymverse (20) low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb) about being forced into a subscription after onboarding; Hevy (4.9, 101k ratings) logs unlimited workouts free, so a generic logger has no gap
30 low-star reviews in 90d (us, gb) about unskippable full-screen ads; Apple Podcasts is free and built in, and Pocket Casts/Overcast have free ad-light tiers

Bose ended the SoundTouch cloud on 2026-05-06: 91 low-star reviews in 2026 (us, gb), 18 in the last 90d and falling, presets and internet radio gone. Bose published the local API, and the gap is already filled: free open-source SoundTouch Reborn (installs on the speaker, restores buttons, radio, Spotify, multiroom), Better ST (⋆4.8, 49 ratings, £6.99, #1 paid Music in be), Bosman (4.5, 39), Mast ($1.99), ST Remote Pro. A fifth controller for a shrinking installed base fails Gate B on 4.3 risk, and needs the hardware to test

75 low-star reviews in 90d (us 68, gb 7) from long-time users losing free sounds and mixes to a ~$70/yr subscription; White Noise is $0.99 one-time (⋆4.8, 46k), iOS Background Sounds are free and built in, and sound mixers are a crowded category
46 stored low-star reviews, ~35 in 90d (us, gb), on ads covering the keypad and $24.99/yr; a template category with a high 4.3 risk, and the iOS Calculator has converted units since iOS 18
~30 low-star reviews in 90d (us) on unskippable ads in DC Metro and Bus; one-city audience, and Citymapper, Transit and Apple Maps cover DC for free

22 low-star reviews in 90d (gb 16, us 6) on ads after every tap in a cute study timer; focus timers are a crowded template category (Forest, Flora, Focus Friend), and the audience is students who rarely pay

targeted scan: PetrolPrices (7 low-star), Lanetalk (10), Rec-all (0), Hours Tracker (4), Melodista (0) had no recurring pain; Musicana (19) is an abandoned streaming player whose songs stopped playing (grey-area content); Fitbit to Apple Health Sync (35) is mostly Google Health migration anger aimed at the wrong app
round 2 scan: Forma 6, Speed Tracker 2, Clay 1, Fitness App 1, PDF Scanner Pro 0 low-star in 90d; nothing recurring

Avenza Maps (128k ratings): ~70 low-star reviews since May 2026, 23 in 90d, us only, after the Blue Marble merger put custom GeoPDF import behind $35-50/yr Plus (20 imports) and ~$170 Pro and froze the map store. Strong pain but killed: Topo Maps+ (4.7, 9.4k ratings) lets free users import up to 10 GeoPDFs; ArcGIS Field Maps (free, no sign-in, GeoPDF since 2026-03) is what wildfire incident pages now point to; MapNero has no import limit even free; ArkenMap $3.99 one-time; NomadTracks free; plus MapCheck, Mapio, FO Maps

Hurricane Tracker (45k ratings): 68 low-star reviews since July 2026 (28 in October, us) after a sale, redesign and forced subscription, one-time buyers locked out; NHC data is public, but National Hurricane Center Data (4.8, 76k, free) and My Hurricane Tracker Pro (4.8, 5.8k, $3.99 one-time) already fill it

The Wonder Weeks (122k ratings): 25 low-star in 90d (us, gb), ~10 in the days after v14.0 (2026-10-28) moved one-time buyers to $5/month; the leap framework is the publisher's proprietary content, reviewers also call it inaccurate, and clones already exist (Baby Leaps $6.99/yr, LittleLeaps, Baby Tracker: Leaps & Weeks); fails Gate B on content rights

Photo Widget. (2.5k ratings): 49 low-star in 90d (us, gb) on a new watermark, ads and ~$12/yr to remove it; the widget is the whole product, so native extension work is the core and fails Gate B; Widgetsmith-style and lifetime photo widget apps already exist

round 1 scan: Countdown App (28; a horror-film novelty, not a tool), Bible Gateway (22; ads, YouVersion free), Magic Poser (43; 3D posing engine), VLC (37; bugs), Airmail (34; mail client), RadarScope (15), Photo Recovery (57; trial traps), Planning Center (12; a church's own system); nothing small and recurring

Timer Plus (61k ratings): 131 low-star reviews in the last 30 days (us 86, gb 51 stored), nearly all since 2026-10-28, when a free interval timer put a hard paywall (~$20) in front of Start and the paid build then crashed on launch on iOS 27; Seconds (24k) got 31 in 90d after its v26 redesign. Biggest surge of the day, but killed: Tabata Timer and HIIT Timer (4.8, 73.7k, free), SmartWOD Timer (4.9, 54k, free), Tabata Timer: Interval Timer (4.9, 9.5k, free), Seconds Pro ($7.99 one-time, 4.8, 12k), plus a wave of 2026 free timers (IntervalFree, PureTimer, GymPulseTimer, Gym Timer); template category with high 4.3 risk

Alarm Clock HD (104k ratings): 35 low-star in 90d (us), 26 on unskippable ads, from 10-15 year users; reliable alarms need native AlarmKit work (same Gate B failure as bugs:alarmy:battery-drain), and the iOS Clock is free

Fishbrain (76k ratings): 41 low-star in 90d (us), 25 on nearly everything needing ~$80/yr Pro; the value is its catch data and community, a two-sided network a new app can't copy (Fishing Points 4.7, 31k has 3 low-star)

round 2 vertical scan: Fabulous (138; billing disputes), RV LIFE (55; routing data), TimeTree (36; mostly a jp update), Songsterr (26) and Oxford Dictionary (24; licensed content), Ride with GPS (21), iCollect (20; ~$100 unlock, 10 relevant, one app), BIGVU (26) and PromptSmart (18; bugs), Trailforks (17), AllStays (17); nothing passed Gate A with a buildable fix. Quiet: Sortly 0, knitCompanion 0, TonalEnergy 2, Strides 2, Days Since 2, Reading List 4, LogTen 4, UDisc 5, FarOut 6
